1.w: The intentions of the heart belong to a man, but the answer of the tongue comes from the Lord .

2.w: All a person’s ways seem right in his own opinion, but the Lord evaluates the motives.

3.w: Commit your works to the Lord , and your plans will be established.

4.w: The Lord has worked everything for his own ends — even the wicked for the day of disaster.

5.w: The Lord abhors every arrogant person; rest assured that they will not go unpunished.

6.w: Through loyal love and truth iniquity is appeased; through fearing the Lord one avoids evil.

7.w: When a person’s ways are pleasing to the Lord , he even reconciles his enemies to himself.

8.w: Better to have a little with righteousness than to have abundant income without justice.

9.w: A person plans his course, but the Lord directs his steps.

10.w: The divine verdict is in the words of the king; his pronouncements must not act treacherously against justice.

11.w: Honest scales and balances are from the Lord ; all the weights in the bag are his handiwork.

12.w: Doing wickedness is an abomination to kings, because a throne is established in righteousness.

13.w: The delight of a king is righteous counsel, and he will love the one who speaks uprightly.

14.w: A king’s wrath is like a messenger of death, but a wise person appeases it.

15.w: In the light of the king’s face there is life, and his favor is like the clouds of the spring rain.

16.w: How much better it is to acquire wisdom than gold; to acquire understanding is more desirable than silver.

17.w: The highway of the upright is to turn away from evil; the one who guards his way safeguards his life.

18.w: Pride goes before destruction and a haughty spirit before a fall.

19.w: It is better to be lowly in spirit with the afflicted than to share the spoils with the proud.

20.w: The one who deals wisely in a matter will find success, and blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord .

21.w: The one who is wise in heart is called discerning, and kind speech increases persuasiveness.

22.w: Insight is like a life-giving fountain to the one who possesses it, but folly leads to the discipline of fools.

23.w: A wise person’s heart makes his speech wise, and it adds persuasiveness to his words.

24.w: Pleasant words are like a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

25.w: There is a way that seems right to a person, but its end is the way that leads to death.

26.w: A laborer’s appetite has labored for him, for his hunger has pressed him to work.

27.w: A wicked scoundrel digs up evil, and his slander is like a scorching fire.

28.w: A perverse person spreads dissension, and a gossip separates the closest friends.

29.w: A violent person entices his neighbor, and then leads him down a path that is terrible.

30.w: The one who winks his eyes devises perverse things, and one who compresses his lips has accomplished evil.

31.w: Gray hair is like a crown of glory; it is attained in the path of righteousness.

32.w: Better to be slow to anger than to be a mighty warrior, and one who controls his temper is better than one who captures a city.

33.w: The dice are thrown into the lap, but their every decision is from the Lord .
